Milbemycin oxime is known to inhibit the function of the Inner centromere protein, indicating a possible pathway through which R-Coluteol may influence this protein. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between R-Coluteol and the Inner centromere protein. The evidence highlights a mechanistic link involving multiple targets, underscoring the complexity of the biological processes involved.
